subject: general
question:
In the following passage, some words have been deleted. Read the passage carefully and select the most appropriate option to fill in each blank.

In the Second World War, the British _________ thousands of so-called interceptors – mostly women – whose job it was to tune in every day and night to the radio _________ of the various divisions of the German military.
solution:
The solution is assembled, broadcasts.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate option to fill in "In the Second World War, the British _________ thousands of so-called interceptors – mostly women – whose job it was to tune in every day and night to the radio _________ of the various divisions of the German military" is assembled, broadcasts. 
 
• In the Second World War, the British assembled thousands of so-called interceptors mostly women whose job it was to tune in every day and night to the radio broadcasts of the various divisions of the German military.
 
• Assembled - (of people) gather together in one place for a common purpose: ​
 
 
• *For example : "*a crowd had assembled outside the gates."
 
 
 
• Broadcast - transmit (a programme or some information) by radio or television: ​
 
 
• *For example : *"the announcement was broadcast live"
 
 
 
• Therefore **option 3 **is the correct option.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's discuss the information about other options :
 
 
• **Assented -** Express approval or agreement. 

 
 
• ​*For example : *"Guest house, then,’ Frank assented cheerfully"
 
 
 
• **Broadsides - **A fierce verbal attack.** **
 
 
• **​***For example :*"He launched a broadside against the economic reforms"
 
 
 
• **Adhered - **Stick fast to (a surface or substance).
 
 
• **​***For example :*"paint won't adhere well to a greasy surface"
 
 
 
• **Broadlooms - **Carpet woven in wide widths.
 
 
• **​***For example :*"wall-to-wall broadloom"
